jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave is looking for a motivated Chief of Staff to join our growing team. At CoreWeave, we are building the next generation public cloud for accelerated workloads. This role will provide direct support to the VP of Engineering, AI/ML ensuring the smooth operation of day-to-day activities and enabling the VP to focus on strategic priorities. The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, experienced assistant or project manager with the demonstrated ability to respond effectively and efficiently while maintaining flexibility, composure and a good sense of humor.

The Chief of Staff serves as a strategic and operational force multiplier, enabling the leadership team to operate at maximum effectiveness across a fast-moving AI Cloud organization. This role blends strategic planning, operational rigor, and cross-functional coordination to drive alignment, execution, and accountability across product, engineering, and partner teams. The Chief of Staff will act as a strategic operating partner - shaping agendas, managing business and operating cadences, ensuring follow-through on priorities, and helping translate strategy into measurable outcomes.

The individual in this role must understand business priorities, demonstrate the ability to proactively anticipate needs and drive improvements to build capacity for the leadership team. The successful candidate will possess the ability to complete complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance, and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround. The ideal candidate must be able to work successfully in a team environment and build effective working relationships inside and outside the group.

About the role:

Strategic Planning & Agenda Management

- Build and manage the executive's agendas for staff meetings, operating reviews, product and engineering forums, and leadership offsites.

- Identify, frame, and prioritize key topics and decisions to ensure meetings are outcome-oriented and aligned with strategic goals.

- Anticipate upcoming decisions and proactively surface risks, tradeoffs, and dependencies.

Business & Operating Cadence Coordination

- Design, maintain, and continuously improve business and operating cadences across product and engineering (e.g., weekly staff meetings, quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, and retrospectives).

- Coordinate inputs, pre-reads, and outputs across teams to ensure consistent, high-quality execution of these cadences.

OKR & Performance Management

- Own executive-level OKR reporting, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and narrative around progress, risks, and mitigation plans.

- Drive accountability by following up on underperforming or at-risk initiatives and facilitating course correction.

Execution & Follow-Through

- Capture key decisions and action items from executive and leadership meetings.

- Ensure clear ownership, deadlines, and visibility for all critical action items.

- Track execution and proactively intervene to remove blockers or escalate issues when needed.

Special Projects & Strategic Initiatives

- Lead or support high-priority, cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the executive office.

- Conduct analysis, develop recommendations, and drive execution on strategic projects related to product strategy, engineering execution, or organizational effectiveness.

- Serve as a trusted thought partner to the leadership on organizational design, prioritization, and scaling challenges.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline); advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus.

- 6+ years of experience in roles such as Chief of Staff, program management, product operations, engineering operations, management consulting, or equivalent.

- Strong familiarity with product and engineering organizations, ideally within cloud infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, or high-growth technology companies.

- Demonstrated experience building and managing operating cadences, executive agendas, and cross-functional coordination.

- Proven ability to track, report, and drive execution against OKRs or similar performance frameworks.

- Exceptional organizational skills with a track record of capturing decisions, managing action items, and ensuring follow-through.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and business topics for executive audiences.

- High degree of discretion, judgment, and professionalism when working with senior leaders and sensitive information.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-paced environments, with a bias toward action and results.

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. As the Director, Operations Accounting, you will serve as a strategic leader within CoreWeave’s Accounting Operations organization, with end-to-end ownership of the technical, operational, and reporting activities supporting our global data center operations. You will define and scale the accounting framework that supports rapid infrastructure growth, while ensuring financial integrity, strong internal controls, and alignment with business objectives.

You will lead and develop a high-performing global team, partner closely with senior leadership across Operations, FP&A, and Technical Accounting, and play a key role in shaping the financial infrastructure that underpins CoreWeave’s expansion. This role reports to the Head of Operations Accounting and requires a balance of strategic vision, technical expertise, and operational execution — starting hands-on as a player-coach and scaling the team from there.

What You'll Do

- Own the function end to end: Provide strategic leadership over the technical, operational, and reporting activities supporting CoreWeave’s global data center operations — owning the accounting and month-end close for supply chain and inventory valuation, standard cost and absorption, fixed assets and capital project accounting (CIP), GRIR management, freight and logistics, and procure-to-pay (P2P).

- Establish the long-term vision: Define and drive a scalable operational accounting framework, including systems, workflows, and organizational design capable of sustaining hyper-growth.

- Build and operate the control environment: Design and execute a robust, SOX-compliant (or equivalent) control environment across operational and technical accounting processes, driving clean audits and year-over-year reductions in findings.

- Lead technical & judgment-heavy accounting: Evaluate, document, and implement accounting treatment for complex transactions in partnership with Technical Accounting and Controllership. Support the accounting review and ongoing management of long-term supplier and commercial agreements to ensure appropriate treatment and contractual alignment.

- Drive systems transformation & integrations: Own the accounting design for supply chain and fixed asset systems and integrations, including ERP implementations, migrations, or upgrades (e.g., NetSuite to Tier-1 platforms like SAP or Oracle), as well as sub-ledger and procurement/WMS integrations.

- Partner across the business: Act as a trusted advisor to Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, FP&A, IT, Tax, Treasury, and Senior Leadership. Partner closely with FP&A on annual budgets, forecasts, and capital planning strategies to fix data at the source and ensure accurate, timely information flow.

- Lead audit readiness & operational excellence: Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors and Internal Audit to ensure timely, accurate deliverables. Continuously review existing processes to simplify, automate, shorten close timelines, and reduce operational risk.

- Build and scale a global team: Start as a hands-on player-coach, then hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing global team from a lean starting point.

Who You Are (Required)

- 10+ years of progressive accounting experience , including senior leadership roles, with broad ownership of technical, operational, cost, or reporting accounting in a high-value, asset-heavy, capital-intensive, or logistics-intensive environment.
